title: MORE Words and Phrases
source: User-provided cropped workbook photo, partial table transcription

entries.example: He finds her and radios the rescue team.
entries.description: To send a message by walkie-talkie

entries.example: The rescue team arrives in the helicopter.
entries.description: A group of people who come and help you in an emergency

entries.example: The rock is wet.
entries.description: A big hard stone

entries.example: He hasn't got a phone and shouts for help.
entries.description: To call very loudly when you are in danger

entries.example: He slips on wet rocks.
entries.description: To fall because the floor is wet or icy

entries.example: Yesterday, there was a storm with strong winds.
entries.description: Very bad weather with strong wind and rain

entries.example: It rained. The rocks are wet.
entries.description: The opposite of dry

entries.example: The mountain rescue team arrives.
entries.description: To come to a place at the end of a trip

entries.example: The helicopter arrives. You're safe!
entries.description: To be out of danger

entries.example: Are you dreaming? No - the man has a jetpack.
entries.description: To see pictures in your head when you sleep

entries.example: You fall down and break your leg.
entries.description: To drop to the ground

entries.example: It is difficult for a helicopter to land on a mountain.
entries.description: What a plane does when it comes down to the ground

entries.example: The rescue team gives you medicine and keeps you warm.
entries.description: Something you take when you are ill

entries.example: It's night-time. The sky is dark.
entries.description: It's above you. It's blue on a nice day.

entries.example: There's a storm. It's very windy.
entries.description: Weather when the air moves a lot and trees shake

entries.example: I can't see anything. It's very dark.
entries.description: At night it is not light, it is ___.

entries.example: She's fifteen. She's a young teenager.
entries.description: The opposite of old

entries.example: I was alone in the mountains.
entries.description: With nobody else

entries.example: My phone was in my backpack.
entries.description: A bag you carry on your back

entries.example: What happened? The helicopter came back.
entries.description: What did ___? Tell me about it!

entries.example: My dog chased a cat in our garden.
entries.description: To run after someone to catch them

entries.example: The weather was sunny in the morning.
entries.description: Weather when the sun shines

entries.example: At the beginning of the school year, we choose a class speaker.
entries.description: The student the pupils choose to talk for all of them

entries.example: In a democracy, the people have the power.
entries.description: A country where the people choose their leaders

entries.example: The mayor is the leader of the town council.
entries.description: The leader of a town

entries.example: Political education is important.
entries.description: About the government and how a country is run

entries.example: People vote for their parliament.
entries.description: To choose someone in an election

entries.example: Diana pressed the button.
entries.description: A small thing you press to turn a machine on

entries.example: There were dark clouds in the sky.
entries.description: A white or grey thing in the sky that brings rain

entries.example: We live on Earth.
entries.description: Our planet

entries.example: The Earth is dying.
entries.description: To stop living

entries.example: There are a lot of trees in the forest.
entries.description: A big place with lots of trees

entries.example: Read the introduction to the radio play.
entries.description: The first part of a book or play that tells you what it is about

entries.example: People are living in spaceships in space.
entries.description: Where the stars and planets are

entries.example: Suddenly, they noticed a little spaceship.
entries.description: To see something suddenly

entries.example: You have to press the button.
entries.description: To push a button with your finger

entries.example: They were in front of a big screen.
entries.description: The part of a TV or computer where you see the pictures

entries.example: That was a great adventure!
entries.description: An exciting and sometimes dangerous trip or experience

entries.example: In the story, the characters are in space.
entries.description: A person in a story or film
You say this before you tell someone surprising news
You say this when you want to hear the rest of a story
